class: The same request handled at one stop and silently ignored at another
symptom: Meta, 30 September: Resume was pressed on a run waiting at its review stop, to load the fixes for its page; the run read the page again with the code it started with and stopped on the same wrong reason.
site: Every run that reaches the review stop
root_cause: run_page_agent loaded new code for 'reload_code' only at the ordinary 'needs you' stop; the review-stop wait handled the other signals and fell through to continue for reload_code.
why_tests_missed: Resume was only ever exercised at a 'needs you' stop.
fix: load_latest_code(agent, assistant, job, experience_data) is the one routine for Resume, called from both stops.
prevention: Every wait for the owner handles the same set of signals through one shared handler.
